svg.aria-label: How tutner.agent_sandbox contains a session: Claude Code under bubblewrap, inside a rootless Podman container, run by the unprivileged account agent, inside a disposable Debian VM on VirtualBox. All traffic must pass an nftables owner rule and the Squid allowlist; everything else is rejected.
svg.text: tutner.agent_sandbox: five layers, each assuming the one inside it can fail

g.text: disposable, snapshotted: baseline + one rolling slot
stops: a kernel exploit from a container reaching the host
no sudo · own subuid range 200000+ · lingering
stops: an escape landing as root or as ansible
crun · pasta network · systemd cgroup v2
stops: reaching other projects, exhausting the VM
every command it runs goes under bubblewrap
• no Read/Edit on the login or settings
stops: commands reading the login or leaving the list
THE ONLY HOST PATHS MOUNTED IN
never $HOME, never ~/.ssh, never the whole projects/ tree
image localhost/agentbox:<tag>, from a root-owned recipe
nothing outlives --rm but /work and the login
filters CONNECT by host, no TLS MITM
passwordless sudo; Ansible logs in here
why the sandbox has its own account
